title: 第13章 幽灵骑士第14章 另一个自己

第十三章幽灵骑士
郝宁手拿着火把以冲刺般的速度向着通道内跑去，但当他在通道中跑了一段时间后却发现他身处的地方，根本不是进来时的通道。
“天呐！这里究竟是怎么一回事，该死！”
这时候郝宁不得不停下脚步，隐形药剂的效果在刚刚已经消耗殆尽，现在的他是暴露在敌人的视线中。
但他却诧异地看着前方，印象中这条通道并没有这么长，大概估算，郝宁多走了一倍的路程！
难道自己走错路了？不可能这里只有一条道路，他刚刚进来的时候已经看得很清楚了，周围墙壁也没有什么暗门之类的东西。
郝宁不信邪地再次往前走去，走了一段距离后，他竟然发现了一个分岔路，两条通道都仿佛通向死亡的大门。
“嗒！”
忽然间郝宁身后传来一声轻响，就像是水滴滴落在地面的声音，莫名的感觉笼罩在他心头。
“谁！”
郝宁心里一紧，连忙回过头望去，火把的光芒把整截通道都照亮，身后的通道内静悄悄的，没有一丝动静。
错觉？郝宁心中不由感到疑惑，刚刚那股诡异的感觉又是什么？
忽然郝宁的身后传来一股冰冷的气息，一点点侵蚀着他的后背。
这种冰冷并不是身体所带来的，而是发从心底感到寒冷，就像是死亡的前兆，令郝宁不寒而栗，对危险的感知使他往前跨出一步，因为这样突如其来的寒冷太诡异了。
就在这时，一道冷风袭来，郝宁只感到背部一痛，一道深可见骨的伤口出现在他背上，强劲的冲击力将他往前推去，跄踉走了两步跌倒在地上。
火把从郝宁手中跌落，火焰熄灭了，整条通道陷入了死一般的黑暗。
他伸手往背上一摸，顿时手掌沾上了一股温热而又粘稠的**，郝宁知道手上的这些是血液，如果不是往前走了一步，他很可能就成了刀下亡魂。
“啊！”郝宁忍着疼痛从地上爬起来，现在通道内已经没有丝毫亮光，他必须想办法搞清楚袭击他的究竟是什么东西！
他警惕地望着四周的黑暗，并且暗暗地从商店列表中再次购买一支火把与六颗子弹，之前没有购买是因为弹药太贵了，一颗子弹足足要10购买点数，所以他一直没能下定决心购买。
郝宁一手拿着火把，一手拿着柯尔特左轮手枪，警惕地望着四周。

当火把再次燃起，通道内顿时亮了起来，通道内依然静悄悄的，只有郝宁一个人，但他背上那狭长的伤口却提示着，现在可不是幻觉，一不小心可是会死的！
嗒的一声，那仿佛水滴的声音再次响起！
又来了！此时郝宁全神贯注地盯着四周，只要看到“怪物”出现，他一定会用手里的枪将它脑袋轰爆！
就在这时候郝宁身后空气扭曲了一下，一个身穿黑色盔甲的身影骤然出现在郝宁身后，仿佛一个刽子手般高高举起手中长剑。
顿时郝宁全身汗毛都竖立起来，巨大的危机感再次出现。他脑海中想都没想，立即将手中的枪指向身后，并且扣动扳机。
“砰！”
刺耳的枪声在通道内响起，郝宁刚刚看到砍伤自己的那个怪物真面目，不，应该说那是一个人！黑色的骑士盔甲，手中拿着一把长剑，在他开枪的瞬间竟然仿佛幽灵般消失得一干二净。
虽然刚刚只是转眼即逝，但侦察术却将它的详细资料都告知了郝宁。
幽灵骑士应该算是人死后的灵魂，跟普通鬼魂不同的是，它们保存了生前身为骑士的记忆与能力，并且能够让人受到实体伤害。
“竟然是20级幽灵骑士，但它比那个斯塔恩也强太多了吧，简直就差好几个等级！”
郝宁觉得这个幽灵骑士比那个斯塔恩强太多了，这个亡灵骑士就像一个杀人无数的杀人犯，而斯塔恩就像是一个新兵蛋子。
“它消失了……现在唯一的办法只有……逃了！”
郝宁警惕地望着四周，但那个幽灵骑士根本没有出现，他看了一眼两条一模一样的通道，脸上不由露出犹豫的表情，如果选错了，很可能就会陷入万劫不复的道路。
但他别无选择，现在只有两个选择，一是留下来跟这个幽灵骑士决一生死，还有一个选择就是走进其中一条通道，去面对那未知的危险。
他一咬牙就往其中一条通道跑去，只有逃跑才有活下去的希望，凭着他手中的左轮手枪根本杀不死那个亡灵骑士，郝宁可没有把希望放在那个不靠谱剑柄上面。
“呼呼呼…………”郝宁的呼吸变得越来越急促，身上的手脚也变得沉重起来。
这一切都是因为背上的伤口在不断流血，如果是一般人早就失血过多昏倒在地面，幸好他经过进化药剂的强化，才不至于出现这样的状况。
忽然郝宁一个跄踉几乎跌倒，只好扶着一旁的墙壁歇息一下，唯一的好消息就是那个幽灵骑士似乎没有追上来。
“尼玛！怎么可能没有回血药剂，你不是商店么！”
刚刚郝宁一直在搜索着游戏中最普遍的回血药剂，但商店给出的答复却是暂时没有货。这不是害死他，估计再这样下去，不用等幽灵骑士前来杀他，他已经失血过多身亡。

“…………我真的要死在这种地方么！肮脏而且又潮湿的地牢！”
时间在一点点地流逝，他身体的血液也在流逝，地上已经形成了一大滩鲜血！就算郝宁是超人也不可能撑太久，他身体所流逝的血液实在太多了。
此时他再也没任何力气支撑自己的身体，手掌一滑就连火把都拿不稳，整个人仿佛一具死尸般瘫倒在地。
忽然郝宁朦胧间看到远处一个人向着他走来，难道是幽灵骑士？但他现在根本没有一点反抗的力量，只能等待着它挥下刀刃，夺走自己的性命。
郝宁用尽全身唯一的力气举起手中左轮手枪，对着那个身影开枪！
砰的一声，左轮手枪从他手中飞了出去，弹道更是偏得离谱，根本没打中那个人影。
“罗尔……罗尔……”那个身影在郝宁面前蹲下，一只呼唤着被他抢夺那身体主人的名字。
借助火把那微弱的光芒，郝宁终于看清楚这个人的真面目，她不是幽灵骑士，她竟然是一个修女。
但……修女怎么会出现在这个地牢中！
………………

content_en:
Chapter 13 Ghost Rider
Hao Ning ran toward the passage at a sprinting speed with a torch in hand, but after running in the passage for a while, he discovered that the place he was in was not the passage he came in from.
"Oh my God! What the hell is going on here, damn it!"
At this time, Hao Ning had to stop. The effect of the invisibility potion had been exhausted just now, and now he was exposed to the enemy's sight.
But he looked ahead in surprise. In his impression, this passage was not that long. He probably estimated that Hao Ning had walked twice as long!
Have you taken the wrong path? There was no way there was only one road here. He had seen it clearly when he first came in, and there were no secret doors or anything like that in the surrounding walls.
Hao Ning walked forward again in disbelief. After walking a certain distance, he unexpectedly found a forked road. Both passages seemed to lead to the door to death.
"Ta!"
Suddenly, there was a soft sound behind Hao Ning, like the sound of water drops falling on the ground, and an inexplicable feeling enveloped his heart.
"Who!"
Hao Ning's heart tightened, and he quickly looked back. The light of the torch illuminated the entire passage. The passage behind him was quiet and there was no movement at all.
illusion? Hao Ning couldn't help but wonder, what was that weird feeling just now?
Suddenly, a cold breath came from behind Hao Ning, eroding his back bit by bit.
This kind of coldness was not brought by the body, but felt cold from the bottom of the heart, like a precursor to death, which made Hao Ning shudder. The perception of danger made him take a step forward, because such a sudden cold was too weird.
At this moment, a cold wind hit, and Hao Ning felt a pain in his back. A wound deep enough to the bone appeared on his back. The strong impact pushed him forward, and he staggered two steps and fell to the ground.
The torch fell from Hao Ning's hand, the flame went out, and the entire passage fell into deathly darkness.
He reached out and touched his back, and his palm was suddenly covered with warm and sticky liquid. Hao Ning knew that the blood on his hand was blood. If he hadn't taken a step forward, he might have become a dead soul under the knife.
"Ah!" Hao Ning endured the pain and got up from the ground. Now that there was no light in the passage, he had to find a way to figure out what was attacking him!
He looked at the darkness around him warily, and secretly purchased another torch and six bullets from the store list. He had not purchased them before because the ammunition was too expensive. A bullet cost 10 purchase points, so he had never made up his mind to buy it.
Hao Ning held a torch in one hand and a Colt revolver in the other, looking around warily.
When the torch was lit again, the passage suddenly lit up. It was still quiet in the passage. Hao Ning was the only one, but the long and narrow wound on his back reminded him that this was not an illusion, and he could die if he was not careful!
With a click, the sound like water drops sounded again!
here we go again! At this time, Hao Ning was staring at the surroundings with all his concentration. As long as he saw a "monster" appearing, he would definitely blow its head off with the gun in his hand!
At this moment, the air behind Hao Ning distorted, and a figure wearing black armor suddenly appeared behind Hao Ning, raising his sword high like an executioner.
Suddenly, all the hairs on Hao Ning's body stood on end, and a huge sense of crisis appeared again. Without a second thought, he immediately pointed the gun behind him and pulled the trigger.
"Bang!"
Harsh gunshots rang out in the passage. Hao Ning had just seen the true face of the monster that slashed him. No, it should be said that it was a person! The black knight's armor, holding a long sword in his hand, disappeared completely like a ghost the moment he fired.
Although it just disappeared in the blink of an eye, the reconnaissance technique informed Hao Ning of all its details.
ghostKnights should be regarded as the souls after death. Different from ordinary ghosts, they retain the memories and abilities of being knights in life, and can cause physical harm to people.
"It's actually a level 20 ghost knight, but it's much stronger than that Starn. It's just several levels behind!"
Hao Ning felt that this ghost knight was much stronger than that Starn. This undead knight was like a murderer who had killed countless people, while Starn was like a new recruit.
"It disappeared...the only way now is...to escape!"
Hao Ning looked around vigilantly, but the ghost knight did not appear at all. He glanced at the two identical passages, and he couldn't help but show a hesitant expression on his face. If he chose the wrong one, he would probably fall into a path of eternal disaster.
But he had no choice. There were only two choices now. One was to stay and fight this ghost knight to death, and the other was to walk into one of the passages and face the unknown danger.
He gritted his teeth and ran towards one of the passages. Only by escaping could he hope to survive. The revolver in his hand could not kill the undead knight, and Hao Ning did not put his hope on the unreliable hilt of the sword.
"Hufufu..." Hao Ning's breathing became more and more rapid, and his hands and feet became heavier.
All this was because the wound on his back was bleeding continuously. If it were an ordinary person, he would have lost too much blood and fainted on the ground. Fortunately, he had been strengthened by the evolutionary potion, so that he would not be in such a situation.
Suddenly Hao Ning stumbled and almost fell, so he had to hold on to the wall to rest. The only good news was that the ghost knight didn't seem to catch up.
"Nah! How could there be no blood-restoring potion? Aren't you a store?"
Hao Ning had just been searching for the most common blood-restoring potion in the game, but the store responded that it was temporarily out of stock. This didn't kill him. If it continued like this, he would have already bled to death without waiting for the Ghost Rider to come and kill him.
"...Do I really want to die in a place like this? A dirty and damp dungeon!"
Time passed little by little, and the blood in his body was also passing by. A large pool of blood had formed on the ground! Even if Hao Ning were Superman, he wouldn't be able to last too long because too much blood was flowing out of his body.
At this moment, he no longer had any strength to support his body. His palms slipped and he could no longer hold the torch, and he collapsed to the ground like a dead corpse.
Suddenly, Hao Ning vaguely saw a person walking towards him in the distance. Could it be the Ghost Rider? But now he has no strength to resist at all, and can only wait for it to swing its blade and take away his life.
Hao Ning used all the strength in his body to raise the revolver in his hand and shoot at the figure!
With a bang, the revolver flew out of his hand, and its ballistic trajectory was even more ridiculous, missing the figure at all.
"Rohr...Rohr..." The figure squatted down in front of Hao Ning, calling out the name of the owner of the body he had robbed.
With the help of the faint light of the torch, Hao Ning finally saw clearly the true face of this person. She was not a ghost knight, she was actually a nun.
But...how could a nun appear in this dungeon!
………………
